# featureflip_segment (Data Source)

Look up a segment by project and key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "featureflip_segment" "beta_users" {
  project = "web"
  key     = "beta-users"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `project` (String)
